item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 27/Sep/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. A broad trough of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the central and northern parts of the South China Sea midweek this week to the period over the weekend. An anticyclone aloft is expected to strengthen gradually early to midweek next week. It will become fine and hot gradually over southern China. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Noru will move towards the central part of Vietnam today and tomorrow. It will then move into the inland areas of Indo-China and weaken gradually.
